presets.name: Gentle pitch wobble
presets.desc: Clean sine vibrato of about 15 cents at 5 Hz, wet only: a light, singing wobble on clean chords
presets.notes: README first application; depth is in cents on Clean (0.15 = 15 cents) and stays the same at any speed

presets.name: Seasick lo-fi warble
presets.desc: Slow, deep, darkened BBD vibrato: a woozy, out-of-tune warble like a stretched cassette

refs.why: Boss VB-2-type wet-only vibrato warble on clean guitar

presets.notes: README 'Seasick'; mix 1 (no dry) is what makes it vibrato rather than chorus

presets.name: Slow detuned glide wash
presets.desc: Very slow, wide BBD pitch drift behind fuzz: chords bend in and out of tune like a held tremolo arm
presets.notes: Random shape at 0.6 Hz bends irregularly instead of cycling, closer to a hand on the bar; place after the fuzz

presets.name: Vintage amp pitch vibrato
presets.desc: Zero-latency phase-modulation vibrato strongest around 1 kHz: the lush true-pitch vibrato of late-50s amps

refs.why: Magnatone amp vibrato (some credit the Bigsby instead)
played a Magnatone Custom 280 with true pitch vibrato

presets.notes: README 'Magnatone amp vibrato'; drive 0.2 adds a little tube colour outside the modulation

presets.name: Vibe-style pitch throb
presets.desc: The vibe's four unequal stages, wet only: a throbbing, liquid pitch vibrato in front of a driven amp

refs.why: Uni-Vibe swirl as the core of his lead sound

presets.notes: README 'Vibe vibrato'; for the vibe's chorus mode use gfx-phaser uni-vibe-throb, or mix 0.5 here

presets.name: Vibrato that grows on held notes
presets.desc: Clean vibrato fading in over 800 ms each time it is engaged: held notes start straight, then sing

refs.why: reportedly moved from a Boss CE-2 to a VB-2 vibrato after Purple Rain

presets.notes: README 'Vibrato that grows' (VB-2 rise time); engage by foot on the note; release ramps only once the bypass hook lands

presets.name: Vibrato-chorus blend
presets.desc: Slow BBD vibrato mixed half and half with the dry: a classic warm chorus built from a pitch vibrato
presets.notes: README 'Chorus from a vibrato'; mix 0.5 is the vibrato/dry blend, stereo 90° spreads the two sides

presets.name: Tonewheel organ deep vibrato
presets.desc: Scanner-type vibrato at its deepest setting, wet only: the shimmering, wavering organ vibrato
presets.notes: Scanner depth 1 = V3 (taps up to 19 of the ladder), speed 6.9 Hz like the rotating capacitor, mix 1 = vibrato

presets.name: Tonewheel organ deep chorus
presets.desc: Scanner vibrato at its deepest blended half with the dry: the thick, animated organ chorus for grooves

refs.why: organ played with the C3 chorus-vibrato setting

presets.notes: Scanner mix 0.5 = the C modes; pair with gfx-rotary on slow or fast for the full organ sound

presets.name: Bass wobble
presets.desc: Moderate BBD vibrato on bass, slightly darkened: a woozy pitch wobble for slow, sparse lines
presets.notes: 20 cents keeps the bass in tune enough to anchor the harmony; there is no bass split here, so the lows move too

presets.name: Lo-fi vocal warble
presets.desc: Light clean pitch vibrato with a random wander on a vocal: a detached, tape-like, slightly unreal voice
presets.notes: 12 cents of random wander reads as tape instability, not as a singer's vibrato; keep it subtle on a lead

presets.name: Tape wow
presets.desc: Slow random pitch drift on any source: the uneven wow of a worn tape machine, for loops and beats
presets.notes: README 'Tape wow'; seeded random LFO so the drift replays the same way each time

presets.name: Tempo-locked quarter warble
presets.desc: Rounded-triangle vibrato locked to quarter notes: the pitch dips in time with the beat on pads or leads
presets.notes: Rounded triangle avoids the square-wave pitch of a plain triangle; speed is ignored while sync is on
